answer: A walnut delivery agent called raven should gain no extra purchasing votes by opening more wallets. Require membership credentials from independent business audits, and anchor each credential to a unique enrollment nullifier so the same business cannot register twice. Keep voting weight nontransferable and cap it per credential. An attacker must establish additional audited businesses and sustain their operating costs, rather than cheaply minting keys; periodic rechecks make rented identities costly to keep.
